# Foxel Apps & Games

> Foxel Apps & Games makes small, calm and cozy apps and games for Android. All of them work without creating an account. / Foxel Apps & Games, Android için küçük, sakin ve sevimli uygulamalar ve oyunlar yapar. Hepsi hesap açmadan kullanılır.

## Apps

- [Focus Room](https://hardsteelgames.github.io/odak-odasi/en.html): Stay off your phone, focus, decorate your room. (On Google Play)
- [Mırıl](https://hardsteelgames.github.io/miril/en.html): A gentle cat who sits beside you while you quit smoking. (On Google Play)
- [Bakedoku](https://hardsteelgames.github.io/bakedoku/en.html): Every number is a pastry. A calm Sudoku. (On Google Play)
- [Foxfect Pairs](https://hardsteelgames.github.io/foxfect-pairs/en.html): A cozy card matching game with a fox. (Coming soon to Google Play)
